changes: Added Web Player V2: a cinematic single-page player (HLS.js / Video.js engine) with live EPG, favorites synchronization and real-time search across Live TV, Movies, Series and Radio.
Added a dedicated Active Codes REST API with administrative and reseller actions — batch generation, status checks, verification, toggling, editing and deletion — each with strict permission scoping.
Integrated the check_active_code endpoint into the Admin and Reseller API wrappers so external portals and applications can validate voucher codes and subscription status programmatically.

Overhauled the Active Codes management screens with advanced DataTables, status filters, date-range pickers, server-side pagination and a redesigned batch generator supporting custom prefixes and mass exports.
Extended Category Templates to resellers and sub-resellers with scoped ownership and shared templates, and added full support for Radio categories across the Admin and Reseller dashboards.
Redesigned the Category Templates breakdown widget with micro-KPI cards (Total, Live, VOD, Series, Radio) and visual distribution bars.
Redesigned reseller panel navigation, separating device management into dedicated menus (MAG, Enigma2, m3u/Xtream, Active Codes).
Separated Users from Catalog into distinct sidebar sections in the Admin dashboard.
Added external Xtream Codes integration for Web Player V2 login, with SSRF egress protection that confines outbound requests to public hosts and disables redirect following.
Standardized country selection across Active Code generation and editing forms using normalized country dropdowns.
Fixed the Web Portal infinite reload loop on missing device information and added automatic device-credential binding on login with active-code fallback.
Fixed white-screen issues during VOD movie playback by hardening the player API, media routing and JSON payload handling.

Preserved authenticated stream-token minting and constant-time secret comparison across all streaming and authentication paths, and reintroduced output escaping on the Active Codes management screens.
